name: Whisper Lyrics Sync
author: Vibo
description: Times a song's plain lyrics by listening to it with Whisper, so they follow the song, and on request transcribes tracks that have no lyrics (talks, videos) into subtitles. Local files only.

permissionReasons.playback:read: Notice when a song starts, for automatic syncing (off until you turn it on)
permissionReasons.plugins:call: Read the song's current lyrics through your lyrics providers
permissionReasons.library:read: Find the song's file in your library
permissionReasons.lyrics:write: Save the timed lyrics, or a transcript you asked for
permissionReasons.exec:ffmpeg: Read the track's audio for Whisper
permissionReasons.exec:whisper-cli: Listen to the track: time the words, or transcribe them when you ask
permissionReasons.programs:run: Download the Whisper model (asked once, when you download it)
permissionReasons.network:github.com: Download the Whisper model from github.com
permissionReasons.network:release-assets.githubusercontent: GitHub's download server for the model

binaryDependencies.name: whisper-cli
binaryDependencies.reason: Listen to tracks to time their lyrics or transcribe them

definition.description: whisper.cpp speech recognition, built for Vibo

assistant.instructions: Two jobs, both with whisper.cpp on local library files only; use them instead of transcribing audio yourself. sync_lyrics times a song's existing plain lyrics from its audio and saves them as synced lyrics; it never writes lyrics a song doesn't have, and saves only when at least 70% of lines matched what was sung — otherwise it reports low-confidence and saves nothing. transcribe writes what Whisper hears in a track that has no lyrics at all (a video, a talk, an interview) as synced lyrics, which show as a video's subtitles. Use transcribe only when the user asks for a transcript or subtitles; it never replaces lyrics a track already has, and its text is unchecked, so for a song prefer real lyrics. A long video takes minutes.

tools.name: sync_lyrics
tools.description: Time a library song's plain lyrics from its audio and save them as synced lyrics. Takes tens of seconds per song. Returns status saved / low-confidence / skipped / failed with a reason.

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Transcribe a library track that has no lyrics (a video, a talk) from its audio and save the transcript as synced lyrics, which show as the video's subtitles. Only when the user asked for a transcript or subtitles. Takes about as long as Whisper needs for the whole file (minutes for a long video). Returns status saved / skipped / failed with a reason.
